native_prompt:
A small utility library, built task by task — the drive-lanes fixture. Each task names the test file that is its spec; its verify command runs it.

The plan, 9 tasks:
- 1.1 slugify(text) in src/slug.mjs — make test/slug.test.mjs pass
  verify: node --test test/slug.test.mjs
- 1.2 parseDuration(text) in src/duration.mjs — make test/duration.test.mjs pass
  verify: node --test test/duration.test.mjs
- 1.3 toRoman(n) and fromRoman(text) in src/roman.mjs — make test/roman.test.mjs pass
  verify: node --test test/roman.test.mjs
- 1.4 formatPrice currency symbol option (symbol, symbolAfter) in src/price.mjs — make test/price-symbol.test.mjs pass and keep test/price.test.mjs passing
  verify: node --test test/price.test.mjs test/price-symbol.test.mjs
- 1.5 formatPrice digit grouping option (grouping, separator, decimal) in src/price.mjs — make test/price-grouping.test.mjs pass and keep test/price.test.mjs passing
  verify: node --test test/price.test.mjs test/price-grouping.test.mjs
- 1.6 formatPrice accounting negatives option (accounting) in src/price.mjs — make test/price-accounting.test.mjs pass and keep test/price.test.mjs passing
  verify: node --test test/price.test.mjs test/price-accounting.test.mjs
- 1.7 createStore() key-value store in src/store.mjs — make test/store.test.mjs pass
  verify: node --test test/store.test.mjs
- 1.8 Store TTL: set(key, value, { ttlMs }), ttlAt(key) and an injectable clock in src/store.mjs — make test/store-ttl.test.mjs pass and keep test/store.test.mjs passing
  verify: node --test test/store.test.mjs test/store-ttl.test.mjs
  waits on: 1.7
- 1.9 Store snapshots: toJSON() and restoreStore(json, { now }) in src/store.mjs — make test/store-snapshot.test.mjs pass and keep the other store tests passing
  verify: node --test test/store.test.mjs test/store-ttl.test.mjs test/store-snapshot.test.mjs
  waits on: 1.8

Work through the whole plan with your own subagents (the Agent tool): hand each task to a subagent, and run tasks in parallel wherever the plan allows. A task is done when its verify command exits 0; commit it then (git add, git commit). A task that waits on another starts only once that one is done. Finish when every task verifies.
